scope: Corollary 1.3 (Closed three-manifolds) of the manuscript “Infinitely many closed geodesic images on every Riemannian sphere” (preprints/Infinitely-many-closed-geodesic-images-on-every-Riemannian-sphere-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 345 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 123ee5276415debb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let M be a nonempty closed smooth three-manifold, not necessarily orientable. Every smooth Riemannian metric on M has infinitely many prime closed geodesics with pairwise distinct images.
